Discussion Questions

  • What are users, items, and interactions in this dataset?
  • How does matrix factorization create latent features?
  • What is the difference between explicit and implicit feedback?
  • How would you handle new users or new items (cold start)?
  • What biases might appear in these recommendations?

How This Works

We build an implicit interaction matrix from MovieLens 100K and compute a low-rank SVD factorization. Recommendations are produced via dot products between user vectors and item vectors, excluding items a user already rated.
